title: User/client API requests and small responses
description: Bodies of CONTRACT_SKETCH §6 operations that are not plain entities. Idempotency rules: docs/API_CONTRACT.md §4.

submit_task_request.description: POST /v1/workspaces/{ws}/tasks (operator). 201 + RemoteTask for a new key, 200 + the same RemoteTask for a repeated key with an equivalent body, 409 conflict for a repeated key with a different body.

ttl_seconds.description: Delivery TTL of the submit command; default 3600.

answer_request.description: POST /v1/tasks/{task}/answer (operator) -> 202 Command; 409 unless the task is waiting_input (checked after the idempotency lookup).

cancel_request.description: POST /v1/tasks/{task}/cancel (operator) -> 202 Command. 409 if the task is already terminal.

retry_request.description: POST /v1/tasks/{task}/retry (operator) -> 202 Command; 409 unless failed/delivery_failed. For delivery_failed the returned command has type 'submit' (redelivery of the original payload), for failed type 'retry'.

empty_request.description: Operations without parameters accept an empty body, '{}' or any object (fields ignored).

ready_response.description: 200 when the database is reachable and migrations are current; otherwise 503 ErrorEnvelope(unavailable) with details.checks.

download_ticket_response.description: POST /v1/artifacts/{art}/download-ticket (viewer). Ticket lives 300 s, is bound to (artifact, user), may be used repeatedly within its lifetime (Range resume) and is re-authorized on every use.

url.description: Path relative to the API origin.
